brand_identity.archetype: The Performance Pro & High-Contrast Swiss Calm
brand_identity.inspiration: Stripe, Linear, and Intercom helpdesk UX — calm, clean, professional, friction-free
brand_identity.tone: Trustworthy, precise, non-intimidating for non-technical small business owners
brand_identity.theme_mode: Dual theme (Light & Dark mode full parity, default to 'Match my device')

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2x-3x typical B2B density for high clarity)
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 44px on all viewport touch targets & mobile buttons
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mode: High Density Data Grid for Analytics & Job Overview cards (gap-4 to gap-6)

navigation_structure.desktop_sidebar: Left fixed sidebar (`civr-side`), graphite surface (#13171c), active indicator bar with accent glow, group labels with subtitle/count badges
navigation_structure.mobile_navigation: Bottom bar + More sheet with touch targets >= 44px

guided_home_spec.header_question: What do you want to do?

task_cards.title: Set up call answering
task_cards.description: Create keypress menus, business hours, and automated call routing

task_cards.title: Get a local or toll-free number
task_cards.description: Instant activation in 50+ countries with call & text support

task_cards.title: Launch outbound voice/text campaign
task_cards.description: Broadcast recorded voice or SMS updates to contact groups

task_cards.title: Deploy AI Phone Agent
task_cards.description: Have AI answer questions, collect info, and take bookings 24/7

page_header.structure: Title + one-line description on the left; primary action CTA button on the top-right
page_header.sub_sections: Under-header horizontal tab strip (`civr-tabstrip`) with active indicator line
page_header.breadcrumbs: Displayed on sub-pages (e.g. Home / Numbers / Details / Answering)

empty_states.pattern: Dashed bounding card (`civr-empty-art`), clear message, single action button ('Get started' or 'Create new')

skeleton_loaders.pattern: Shimmer skeletons (`civr-skel`) instead of raw spinners for all data loading states

component_specs.civr-card: Background `var(--c-card)`, border `1px solid var(--c-border)`, radius `var(--radius-card)` (12px), transition border & shadow on hover
component_specs.civr-btn: Min height 44px on mobile / 42px desktop, radius 12px / pill 999px, font weight 600, micro-animation scale down 0.98 on click
component_specs.civr-input: Height 44px, background `var(--c-bg)`/card tint, 1px border `var(--c-border)`, focus outline 3px soft accent ring
component_specs.civr-pill: Height 28px-36px, rounded 999px, status indicators (pill-ok, pill-warn, pill-bad, pill-on)
component_specs.civr-table: Clean tabular alignment, header uppercase 12px font, hover state row background tint `#171717` (dark) / `#f8fafc` (light)

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, links, inputs, cards, tabs, and status badges MUST carry a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid='nav-home-link'`, `data-testid='quick-call-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure CSS variables for light and dark modes are properly mounted under html[data-civr-theme='light'] and html[data-civr-theme='dark'] in `cloudivr.css` / `theme-clean.css` / `theme-light.css`.
Maintain complete visual and functional parity between Light and Dark mode.
Do not break existing civr- standard class names so legacy pages smoothly adopt the redesign.
Implement the job-grouped left sidebar menu and touch-friendly mobile navigation with min 44px touch targets.
Implement the guided task-based home screen with setup cards, setup progress checklist, and compact overview.
Enforce standard PageHeader with title, subtitle, primary action, and TabStrip on sub-pages.
Add keyboard navigation and ⌘K Command Palette.
Ensure all interactive components have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: do not center-everything, use Inter everywhere for headings, or add gratuitous gradients.
Respect contrast ratios: minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and interactive buttons.
Always set explicit text color on hover states.
Use 2-3x more spacing than default cramming.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all micro-animations and skeletons.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on headers or dropdown popovers.
